title: Framing Differ — Output Framed Cluster Record
description: One framed cluster per line in framings.jsonl. Inherits cluster identity + bias data from bias_scorer's output and adds: consensus_headline_art selection (article whose headline has maximum word overlap with other cluster members), per-article framing cards (headline + lede + source + image + video), and per-cluster image/video pick. Behaviour extracted from generate_feed.py:583-657 (consensus_headline_art + article_cards build).

consensus_hash.description: Hash of the cluster article chosen as the consensus framing (highest shared-word score per consensus_headline_art logic).

consensus_headline.description: Headline of the consensus article — used as the story's display headline.

consensus_summary.description: Article description of the consensus article (truncated to 300 chars downstream).

consensus_source.description: Source id of the consensus article.

image_url.description: First non-null image_url across cluster articles in iteration order. Drives the story hero image.

video_url.description: First non-null video_url across cluster articles in iteration order.

snippet.description: get_snippet() output — full_text if >150 chars and boilerplate-free, else description; truncated at word boundary to 300 chars.

article_cards.description: Per-cluster-article framing data. Same order as scored.member_hashes (which is the cluster's greedy-assignment order).
